# Commands console reliability, hidden browser, and review-queue workflows

`patch-update-dialog.js` holds a pre-start state for Verify/Review Update, renders the chooser and explicit Start button, and sends `checkoutMode` only when preparation begins. Keep `.patch-update-steer[hidden] { display: none; }`; close-before-session clears `pendingStart`, while started sessions retain normal minimize/resume behavior. Browser tests were 6/6 and focused backend/task tests 132 passed. [Task 14]

Scope: console.
